finding: The anki project at ~/work/github/anki/ contains 3 subprojects: (1) koine-anki/ — standalone git repo for Anki flashcard decks (compounds + grammar endings), (2) koine-pimsleur/ — standalone git repo for 90-lesson Pimsleur audio course, (3) anki-main/languages/ — standalone git repo that was the ORIGINAL monorepo containing both Anki deck + Pimsleur code before being split into koine-anki and koine-pimsleur.

koine-anki README: Koine Greek Anki Decks. Two deck types: (1) compounds/ — 290 compound word flashcards with etymological decomposition, Strong's refs, Spanish mnemonics. Pipeline: extract_compounds→fetch_strongs→enrich_compounds→improve_mnemonics→generate_deck. (2) terminaciones/ — grammar endings flashcards (verb conjugations, infinitives, participles). Data from MorphGNT/SBLGNT, Strong's Greek Dictionary, openscriptures/LxxLemmas. Setup: genanki + py-sblgnt.

koine-pimsleur README: 90 audio lessons (16.7 hours) teaching ~600 Koine Greek words covering ~90% of NT text using Pimsleur method. 3 levels (30 lessons each). Tech: Amazon Polly (Spanish narration), Google Cloud TTS (Greek speech), pydub+ffmpeg (audio assembly), genanki (Anki decks), Amazon Bedrock/Claude (LLM enrichment). Depends on koine-anki sibling repo for NT corpus and morphology data.

anki-main/languages README: Combined README covering both Anki deck (290 compounds) and Pimsleur audio course (90 lessons). This was the original monorepo before the split. Same tech stack as koine-pimsleur. Contains both src/ (Pimsleur + compounds pipeline) and data/ (NT corpus, Strong's dictionary).

anki-main/languages/src/ contains 16 Python files: __init__.py (empty), engine.py (Pimsleur lesson builder from structured data), tts.py (TTS module: Polly+Google Cloud), generate.py (CLI lesson generator), render.py (MP3 renderer from JSON), script_builder.py (lesson script JSON generator), enrich.py (LLM enrichment via Bedrock), generate_decks.py (Anki deck generator from lessons), generate_deck.py (Anki deck from enriched compounds), extract_compounds.py (extract compounds from NT MorphGNT), enrich_compounds.py (add suffix explanations+mnemonics), fetch_strongs.py (fetch Strong's etymological data), improve_mnemonics.py (improve mnemonics with enriched data), download_lxx.py (download Septuagint lemma data), generate_test_5min.py (5-min test lesson), generate_test_15min.py (15-min test lesson).

koine-pimsleur/src/ contains 9 Python files (identical to the Pimsleur subset of anki-main/languages/src/): __init__.py, engine.py, tts.py, generate.py, render.py, script_builder.py, enrich.py, generate_decks.py, generate_test_5min.py, generate_test_15min.py. Plus src/data/ with 23 lesson data files.

koine-anki/compounds/ contains 10 Python files: generate_deck.py (generate Anki deck — EVOLVED version with cognates+verses sections), extract_compounds.py (extract from NT), fetch_strongs.py (Strong's data), enrich_compounds.py (suffix+mnemonic enrichment), improve_mnemonics.py (improve mnemonics), download_lxx.py (LXX download), enrich_cognates.py (NEW: re-enrich with cognates per component via Wiktionary+LLM), audit_cognates.py (NEW: audit all cognates with strict etymological accuracy), enrich_verses.py (NEW: enrich with Greek verses from MorphGNT), add_rvr60.py (NEW: add RVR60 Spanish translation to verses).

anki-main/languages/src/ vs koine-anki/compounds/ comparison: 5 files are BYTE-FOR-BYTE IDENTICAL (extract_compounds.py, enrich_compounds.py, fetch_strongs.py, improve_mnemonics.py, download_lxx.py). generate_deck.py DIVERGED — koine-anki version is newer (8067 bytes vs 4769) with added cognates_by_part section, Greek verses section, and bumped MODEL_ID/DECK_ID. koine-anki has 4 NEW scripts not in anki-main: enrich_cognates.py, audit_cognates.py, enrich_verses.py, add_rvr60.py. Conclusion: koine-anki/compounds/ is the ACTIVE development fork of the compounds pipeline; anki-main/languages/src/ is the frozen original.

koine-anki/terminaciones/ contains 16 Python files: gen_deck.py (Vol.2 infinitives text export), gen_deck_vol3.py (Vol.3 full paradigms .apkg), cards_cat1-7.py (card data for 7 grammar categories), cards_vol3_cat1-7.py (Vol.3 card data). This is a grammar endings deck generator not present in anki-main/languages/src/ (only in kiro-test/).
